visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Items Can Be Taken Repeatedly
visualizerParams.problemDescription: With capacity 10 and each item allowed once, the best value is 13, but the program prints 14.

solution.explanation: Going upwards, dp[w - weight] may already include the current item, so the same item is added again and again (two items of weight 5 and value 7 give 14). Going downwards, dp[w - weight] still holds the value from before this item.
